source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section C; instructions PDF p17 Section C Lines 1-2 and Worksheet for Lines 1 and 2; Reference Guide PDF p9; record social_security_retirement_subtraction

worked: Single, age 62. Born 1964-01-01: 62 for 2025 by the day-before-the-birthday rule, so the benefits are exempt. Federal taxable Social Security: other income 40,000.00 + half of benefits 15,000.00 = provisional 55,000.00; 85% x (55,000.00 - 34,000.00) + 4,500.00 = 22,350.00. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 40,000.00 + taxable Social Security 22,350.00 = 62,350.00. Federal taxable income = 62,350.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 46,600.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 62,350.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 62,350.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 62,350.00 - 0.00 = 62,350.00. MO-A Part 3 Section C (Y, age 62): Line 1 22,350.00; Line 3 22,350.00 (62 or older by December 31). Section C Line 4 total 22,350.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 22,350.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 62,350.00 - 22,350.00 - 15,750.00 = 24,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 24,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,313.00 = 32.825 + 3% x 1,313.00 = 39.39 + 3.5% x 1,313.00 = 45.955 + 4% x 1,313.00 = 52.52 + 4.5% x 1,313.00 = 59.085 + 4.7% x 15,059.00 = 707.773; total 963.808 = 963.81. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 964; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 62,350.00 - Line 8 22,350.00 = 40,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 62,350.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
